title: The write step hides plan decisions by emptying slots in one contract call, drops refused slots and retries, and reads the result back
steps: S1: Run the write step hide tests against the fake site door of apps/tracy-web/test/write-step-hide.test.mjs.
S2: A hidden slot is sent as empty_slots in the one contract call; a slot the plugin refuses is dropped and the rest sent again; an older plugin that takes no hide order gets nothing sent.
S3: Read the whole run back from the written site.
expect: S1: every named test reports ok.
S2: refused slots are failed in the plugin words and the others still go; nothing is pretended when the plugin cannot hide.
S3: the run reads back green from the site it wrote, and red when a hidden block comes back.
evidence: Before this branch no code wrote a build's hide decisions to a site
fence: The hide stage of the write step, checked on a fake site door that answers like the real apply door

tests: a hidden slot goes as empty_slots in the one contract call
a slot the plugin refuses is dropped and retried
an older plugin takes no hide order
the whole run reads back green from the site it wrote
